terra.problem: The passage says the sons were set apart to prophesy with instruments, not for band practice.
The joke assumes a treasury guard needs to sneak up on people. That connection doesn't make sense.
“Strings attached” is a phrase with a well-known second meaning.
The claim that prophets sometimes carry hard messages brings in a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
“To humble him” and “to exalt him” are not close in sound.
